title: File:Halley VI Antarctic Research Station - Science modules.jpg
desc: The Halley Research Station is a research facility in Antarctica. This image is of the Halley VI buildings consisting of a string of eight modules jacked up on hydraulic legs to keep it above the accumulation of snow.
